neighbours.label: a concessive 'nevertheless' connective that opens a clause against what came before (' yet', German 'Trotzdem', French 'pourtant'); plain 'but', 'although' and temporal 'not yet' stay quiet
fire: The hotel was expensive and far from the beach, yet we booked it again this year.
He had lost every early match. And yet, by the end of the season, he was champion.
The data looked weak at first, yet the effect survived every later test.
She knew the risks of the climb, yet she went up alone at dawn.
Die Straße war gesperrt. Trotzdem fuhren viele Autos einfach weiter.
Das Wetter war schlecht. Trotzdem kamen fast tausend Besucher zum Fest.
Le film a reçu de mauvaises critiques, et pourtant il a rempli les salles.
Il avait tout préparé avec soin, et pourtant rien ne s'est passé comme prévu.
quiet: The hotel was expensive and far from the beach, but we booked it again this year.
He had lost every early match, although by the end of the season he was champion.
The final data have not come in yet, so the report will be late.
She knew the risks of the climb, so she went up with two guides.
Die Straße war gesperrt, weil dort ein Baum umgefallen war.
Das Wetter war schön, und fast tausend Besucher kamen zum Fest.
Le film a reçu de bonnes critiques, et il a rempli les salles.
Il avait tout préparé avec soin, mais il a oublié les billets.

predictions: fire 0.5-1.0 on concessive yet/Trotzdem/pourtant; but/although/temporal yet below 0.1
notes: Card: ' yet' x21, 'dem' (Trotzdem), ' doch', 'tant' (pourtant). Probe: ', yet nobody' 0.633, 'And yet,' 0.877, 'Trotzdem' 0.954, 'pourtant' 1.014; same clause with ', but' 0.064, ', although' 0.052; temporal 'not arrived yet' 0.010; modal particle 'doch' 0.122. The pole marks the concessive turn, not contrast in general.
